question: Which of the following hormones stimulates the growth of all organs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Growth hormone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **growth hormone** is produced by the pituitary gland.
 
• It plays a crucial role in stimulating the growth of all organs and tissues in the body.
 
• Growth hormone promotes protein synthesis and increases muscle mass.
 
• It also influences the metabolism of fats and carbohydrates.
